I tried it — pasted a link, clicked **Get details**, and the little preview came up with the site name, a title, and a description. Yes, that's the right idea, and the layout feels good: one clear box front and center, and I like getting to look things over before it's actually saved. That preview step is reassuring.

Two things I'd want while we're here, both about that preview:

- Sometimes the title a page gives itself is clunky or too long. Before I hit **Save**, I'd want to be able to tweak the title and the description myself, right there — not be stuck with exactly what came back.
- It'd help me recognize a link at a glance if the preview also picked up the little site icon and, if the page has one, a thumbnail image. That's part of what makes a saved link feel "filled in" to me.

Otherwise the flow is what I pictured. Can we get those adjustments in?
